AI Operations Engineer- AI Agent, AI Tool
In this role, you will build AI-powered tools for Agentic Operations and the agentic platform.
Your Impact
• Develop agentic workflows that apply AI and machine learning to risk and incident management, anomaly detection, root cause analysis.
• Conceptualize, develop, deploy, and continually refine machine learning models and AI agents for operational use cases.
Minimum Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree and 7+ years of related experience, or a master’s degree and 4+ years of related experience, or a PhD and 1+ year of related experience.
• Strong software engineering experience building and delivering operational software tools or platform capabilities.
Preferred Qualifications
• Working experience building AI agents or agentic systems.
